feature: RFC 8441 WebSocket through an HTTP CONNECT proxy

scope.origin: independent Hyper rustls HTTP/2 Extended CONNECT server
scope.transport: certificate-verified TLS 1.3 with mandatory h2 ALPN
scope.websocket: fragmented masked text, unmasked response, Ping/Pong with interleaved application data, and bounded Close 1000/done

boundaries.proxy: requires exact localhost:port CONNECT authority and Basic proxy authentication
boundaries.origin: requires HTTP/2 CONNECT, protocol websocket, https scheme, exact localhost:port authority, WebSocket version 13, and no Proxy-Authorization
boundaries.tls: certificate hostname verification, h2 ALPN, TLS KeyUpdate, and exporter bytes remain bound to the origin rather than the proxy
boundaries.deadline: one bounded client setup spans proxy CONNECT, TLS, HTTP/2 bootstrap, and RFC 8441 negotiation

results.h2c: fragmented text, Ping/Pong with interleaved data, and bounded Close passed
results.direct_tls: certificate verification, h2 ALPN, KeyUpdate, exporter, WebSocket exchange, and Close passed
results.proxied_tls: Hyper CONNECT proxy, exact scheme and authority, credential isolation, TLS metadata, WebSocket exchange, and Close passed

remaining_gap: browser API coverage for RFC 8441 remains limited by browser implementations; this gate independently covers the wire, proxy, TLS, and HTTP/2 layers
